topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I stepped outside this morning to the quiet, expected routine of my day. Instead, my driveway was empty where my car usually rests. The neighbors were out, giving me a nod as they passed, and I saw the small ticket on the ground, a stark white slip among the morning shadows. A quick call confirmed the worst – my car had been towed. It's a setback, certainly, but not one that can't be addressed. I took a moment, collected my thoughts, and made the call to arrange for its retrieval. In the meantime, I considered the quiet driveway and decided to use the unexpected free time to catch up on a few tasks around the house.
